load_retriever_model: load a Contriever or XLMRetriever model with tokenizer from a local checkpoint or HuggingFace model path
create_contriever_embeddings: create dense text embeddings using the Contriever class with average or CLS pooling strategies
create_xlm_embeddings: create multilingual dense text embeddings using the XLMRetriever class based on XLM-RoBERTa
normalize_embeddings: normalize Contriever or XLMRetriever output embeddings using L2 normalization via the forward pass
review_pooling_strategy: review the Contriever or XLMRetriever pooling strategy to switch between average and CLS token pooling
